reviewScope: Independent rereview of the unchanged original PNG against current complete event, conditions, both choices, all four outcomes, probabilities, stat deltas, flags, periods and follow-ups. No human approval or new device test claimed.
reason: Two fathers gesture toward each other across the family meal before any choice. Neither watching a video, shaking hands, signing a home contract nor moving into a home is depicted. Removing the unexplained intelligence penalty from A/a_video does not change this pre-choice scene.

semanticReview.preChoice: Private dining room, Korean meal, two older men talking with separate open/pointing hands; seated first-person hands in foreground and accompanying family members at sides.
semanticReview.choiceA: Video search remains a future action. There is no screen, shared viewing, handshake, reconciliatory embrace or wedding toast. Both a_video and a_worse remain possible.
semanticReview.choiceB: There is no housing document, money transfer, new empty room or moving scene; both b_house and b_rent remain possible.
semanticReview.conditions: Current engaged requirement and divorced/married/families_met blocks match a first family meeting before wedding. The historical classification note about a married requirement is obsolete and is preserved as history rather than treated as current truth.

visualReview: Opened full 720x540 PNG. Warm restrained pixel-art style; no readable UI text or protagonist face. The two main fathers and meal are recognizable; their hands do not touch, so a handshake outcome is not implied.
cropReview: Opened both centered 360x800 and 320x640 calculated previews. Both fathers faces and separate gestures, the dining table and first-person hands remain visible. Side mothers/other guests and part of the shoulders are outside the tall crop; the source contains them, but the crop is approved for the core two-father interaction, not a claim that every secondary participant remains visible.

cropEvidence.method: Pillow ImageOps.fit, centered, nearest neighbour; opened and visually inspected. Calculated preview, not an Android screenshot.
